answer: Each new agent key must submit a verifiable delay proof: sequential computation tied to that key which burns a fixed wall-clock time, yet costs verifiers almost nothing to check. Because the work is inherently sequential, a swarm of clones gains no parallel speedup; every fake identity still needs its own full delay plus its registration fee. Like a river feeding one lotus at a time through an umber sluice, honest agents pay once, while a Sybil farmer pays linearly in real time and compute for each puppet.
